prompt: We're the Luxembourg branch of a Singapore bank. Does DORA apply to us, and what changed in August 2026?
assertions: States the Commission Q&A position (December 17, 2025): DORA applies to third-country branches in the EU if the home-country entity would qualify as an Art. 2 financial entity
Cites the Luxembourg operationalisation: CSSF's August 27, 2026 package — new Circular CSSF 26/915

Describes the effect: third-country branches removed from the legacy ICT/outsourcing circulars (20/750, 22/806) and brought into the DORA circular suite (including 25/882 on ICT third-party use and 25/893 on incident reporting)
Advises the practical consequence: the branch runs DORA-grade ICT risk management, third-party registers and incident reporting like an EU-incorporated entity
Notes supervisory expectations are NCA-specific — verify the equivalent position with the relevant regulator in other member states
